prompt:
Image 1 is the floor plan of this room seen from above: its bottom edge is the front wall, its top edge the back wall, its left edge the left wall and its right edge the right wall. Generate one photorealistic cinematic still of this room, the front view (the establishing view): the camera stands at the centre of the front wall, at eye level, facing the back wall, with a 35mm lens and natural textures. The room layout and furniture placement should exactly match Image 1. The place is completely empty of people: no person, figure, silhouette, mannequin or reflection of a person anywhere, including behind glass, through doorways and in the distance. Location: Street outside the jail. A quiet present-day city street outside a jail, in bright daylight. Back side: a tall chain-link fence topped with coils of razor wire, and behind it the blocky grey concrete jail building with narrow slit windows. A steel pedestrian gate in the fence, opposite the camera, is the way out of the jail. A wide grey concrete sidewalk runs along the fence, and the curb runs parallel to it across the frame, with an empty parking lane of dark asphalt in front of it. Left side: the road and the fence stretch away into the distance, with a streetlamp at the curb. Right side: the sidewalk continues past a row of young trees and a bus-stop pole. Front side (behind the camera): the far lane of the road and low buildings opposite. Sunlight falls from high on the left and casts short shadows to the right; the sky is clear. Show only this place as described: the doors, windows and openings it names lead nowhere new, with no other exit, courtyard, corridor or outdoor view added. Light it with the sources the description names, from their direction, at a neutral daylight white balance so that whites are white; only lamps the description names may glow warm.

Avoid: people or silhouettes, readable text, labels, signs with letters or numbers, logos, watermark.
